background: SMBC Bank International is the London-based bank of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, serving the Japanese group's corporate and institutional clients across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, funded by corporate deposits and the parent.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A on average and the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 8 Dec 2022. Capital is the strength, with CET1 of 20.7% in the top quarter of UK mid-sized banks after rising 3.8 points since 30 Jun 2025, and leverage of 8.2% above the median despite falling 0.9 points. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 156% below the median and broadly flat, while NSFR of 138% is above it after rising 13 points. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
